title: The Fundamentals of Singapore's Foreign Policy: Then and Now
summary: Lee Kuan Yew argued that a small country should maintain many useful relationships while preserving its sovereignty and freedom to act. He linked relevance and mutual interests to national survival and prosperity.

title: Tanjong Pagar GRC Family Day
summary: Lee Kuan Yew described Singapore's lack of natural resources as a constraint and emphasized education, hard work, and human capability as ways the country could overcome that disadvantage.

title: Tanjong Pagar 44th National Day Celebration Dinner
summary: Lee Kuan Yew stressed confronting national difficulties directly, working together, and resolving problems rather than hoping they would disappear.

title: National Day Message 2015
summary: The Prime Minister's Office recalled Lee Kuan Yew's 1965 commitment that Singapore would be a multiracial nation in which people would have an equal place regardless of language, culture, or religion.
